method: Add a separation cost for each sample and its reflection across the fold. Exempt the final 1.5 nominal widths of path length. Keep all existing geometry and image objectives; geometric core checks supplement the lattice at checkpoints. A separate arm also reduces the same-cut arc exclusion from eight to three nominal widths.
sourcePolicy: Frozen image-fitted cuts are continuation starts. Photograph bytes, crop coordinates, masks, colors and settings stay unchanged. No published templates and no fresh-fit speed claim.

hunodan.visualReview: Original and repaired independent weaves retain the same visible motif; the measured difference is small but nonzero.

limits: All four selected outputs pass independent nominal and radius-bracket polygon checks; normal-original remains uncertain under the current coarse raster gate.
This does not yet preserve every historical pixel-error score: the Hunodan repair adds about 0.020 percentage points.
Always applying the mirror force slightly worsens the two already-valid cold controls, so a blanket change is not selected.
The mirror force alone does not repair the non-fold hook; reducing the existing same-cut exclusion is also needed in that case.
Finite-difference testing, fresh solver runs, browser integration and release benchmarking remain before production adoption.
